items.question: When was the Meridian lighthouse lantern first lit?
items.reference_answer: The Meridian lighthouse lantern was first lit on March 12, 1886.

items.question: Who tended the Meridian lighthouse from that first night until her retirement in 1909?
items.reference_answer: Keeper Ada Voss tended the light from that first night until her retirement in 1909.

items.question: What was the crown ring cast in by the Barbizon Glassworks?
items.reference_answer: Its crown ring was cast in naval bronze by the Barbizon Glassworks.

items.question: What serial number does the compressed-air diaphone installed in 1911 carry?
items.reference_answer: The compressed-air diaphone installed in 1911 carries serial number DH-44.

items.question: What night crossing fare does the ferry compact set for a horse cart?
items.reference_answer: The ferry compact sets the night crossing fare for a horse cart at 40 cents.

items.question: When does the ferry compact open the dawn freight window?
items.reference_answer: The ferry compact opens the dawn freight window at 4:10 a.m.

items.question: Who does the ferry compact name as arbitrator?
items.reference_answer: The ferry compact names Judge Inez Calder of the county court as arbitrator.

items.question: How many meteors did Mara Ellison log at the Cedar observatory during the August 1908 Perseid watch?
items.reference_answer: Mara Ellison logged 214 meteors at the Cedar observatory during the August 1908 Perseid watch.

items.question: Why did Cedar observatory retire barometer number 17?
items.reference_answer: Cedar observatory retired barometer number 17 after the glass cracked in the January 1912 freeze.

items.question: Which way does the Cedar observatory dome slit face?
items.reference_answer: The Cedar observatory dome slit faces 12 degrees west of true north.

items.question: How many bushels did Noah Briggs certify for the 1904 municipal salt harvest?
items.reference_answer: Noah Briggs certified the 1904 municipal salt harvest at 1,840 bushels.

items.question: Why did the salt warehouse reject the 1906 Dunn shipment?
items.reference_answer: The salt warehouse rejected the 1906 Dunn shipment because its moisture measured 6.5 percent.
